name: wiki-playbook-review
description: > Weekly playbook review: rewrite the vault's how-to pages (skills/ playbooks, runbooks) from the week's evidence (meetings, journals, postmortems, new pages) and stage every revision for the owner to approve as a diff. Use for "review my playbooks", "/wiki-playbook-review", "update the playbooks from this week", "friday playbook rewrite", "what should we stop doing". Not for a summary of what was learned (wiki-digest) or for creating a new agent skill (skill-creator).
author: Ar9av
